=== zapp.check_duplicate_request(p_request_id text, p_action text, p_user_id uuid) [] SETOF record
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.check_duplicate_request(p_request_id text, p_action text, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(is_duplicate boolean, status_code integer, cached_result jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rec zapp.processed_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_rec
  FROM   zapp.processed_requests
  WHERE  request_id = p_request_id
    AND  action     = p_action
    AND  user_id    = p_user_id
    AND  expires_at > now()
  LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT TRUE, v_rec.result_status, v_rec.result_payload;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY SELECT FALSE, NULL::INTEGER, NULL::JSONB;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_agent_metrics()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'agentes', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'nome',a.name,'status',a.status,'modelo',a.model,'skills',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_installed_skills WHERE agent_id=a.id))) FROM agents a WHERE a.status='production'),

        'gerado_em', NOW()
    ) INTO result;
    RETURN result;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.fn_outbound_dispatch_apply(p_batch_size integer) [] SCALAR integer
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_outbound_dispatch_apply(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'net'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_row    record;
  v_resp   record;
  v_applied int := 0;
BEGIN
  -- BUG FIX v6.2.8a: coluna e 'content', nao 'body'; adicionar FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  -- para evitar race condition com crons concorrentes
  FOR v_row IN
    SELECT q.id, q.external_id::bigint AS req_id
    FROM zapp.outbound_message_queue q
    WHERE q.status = 'sending'
      AND q.sent_at < now() - interval '3 seconds'
      AND q.external_id IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT p_batch_size
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    BEGIN
      -- FIX: coluna chama-se 'content', nao 'body'
      SELECT status_code, content AS body, timed_out, error_msg
      INTO v_resp
      FROM net._http_response
      WHERE id = v_row.req_id;

      IF FOUND THEN
        -- Timeout de rede: tratar como falha
        IF v_resp.timed_out IS TRUE THEN
          UPDATE zapp.outbound_message_queue
          SET
            status        = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,
            retry_count   = retry_count + 1,
            error_message = 'pg_net timeout: ' || coalesce(v_resp.error_msg, 'request timed out'),
            failed_at     = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
            updated_at    = now()
          WHERE id = v_row.id;
        ELSIF v_resp.status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN
          UPDATE zapp.outbound_message_queue
          SET status='sent', updated_at=now()
          WHERE id=v_row.id;
        ELSE
          -- BUG FIX v6.2.8b: usar > em vez de >= para corrigir off-by-one no retry
          UPDATE zapp.outbound_message_queue
          SET
            status        = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,
            retry_count   = retry_count + 1,
            error_message = left(coalesce(v_resp.body::text, v_resp.error_msg, 'http_'||v_resp.status_code::text), 500),
            failed_at     = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
            updated_at    = now()
          WHERE id=v_row.id;
        END IF;
        v_applied := v_applied + 1;
      END IF;
      -- Se nao FOUND: request ainda em flight (< 3s), ignorar e tentar no proximo ciclo
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      -- Erro inesperado: logar no error_message sem travar o loop
      UPDATE zapp.outbound_message_queue
      SET error_message = left('apply_exception: '||SQLERRM, 500), updated_at=now()
      WHERE id=v_row.id;
    END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_applied;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.fn_outbound_sending_reaper() [] SCALAR integer
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_outbound_sending_reaper()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_reaped int;
BEGIN
  UPDATE zapp.outbound_message_queue
  SET
    status        = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,
    retry_count   = retry_count + 1,
    error_message = 'reaper: sending stuck > 15min sem resposta pg_net',
    failed_at     = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > max_retries THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
    external_id   = NULL,
    sent_at       = NULL,
    updated_at    = now()
  WHERE status = 'sending'
    AND sent_at < now() - interval '15 minutes';
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_reaped = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_reaped;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.fn_register_instance(p_instance_name character varying, p_display_name character varying, p_phone character varying, p_department character varying, p_responsible character varying) [] SCALAR uuid
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_register_instance(p_instance_name character varying, p_display_name character varying, p_phone character varying, p_department character varying, p_responsible character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Registrar instância na tabela canônica zapp.instance_registry.
  -- DB-03: o corpo antigo apontava para instance_registry no schema do provider
  -- (inexistente), o que fazia a chamada falhar.
  INSERT INTO zapp.instance_registry (instance_name, display_name, phone_number, department, responsible_name)
  VALUES (p_instance_name, p_display_name, p_phone, p_department, p_responsible)
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  -- Provisionamento das partições, índices, RLS e policies do lado do provider
  -- fica atrás do contrato (rpc_boundary_provision_instance_partitions).
  PERFORM evo.rpc_boundary_provision_instance_partitions(p_instance_name::text);

  RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.fn_send_audio_meme(p_remote_jid text, p_instance_name text, p_audio_meme_id uuid, p_created_by uuid) [] SCALAR jsonb
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_send_audio_meme(p_remote_jid text, p_instance_name text, p_audio_meme_id uuid, p_created_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_meme record;
  v_queue_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_meme FROM audio_memes WHERE id = p_audio_meme_id;
  IF v_meme IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'audio_meme_id nao encontrado no catalogo');
  END IF;
  
  INSERT INTO outbound_message_queue (
    remote_jid, instance_name, message_type, content,
    media_url, media_mime_type, ptt, audio_meme_id,
    metadata, status, retry_count, max_retries, created_by
  ) VALUES (
    p_remote_jid, p_instance_name, 'audio', '',
    v_meme.audio_url, 'audio/ogg; codecs=opus', true, p_audio_meme_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'meme_name', v_meme.name,
      'meme_category', v_meme.category,
      'duration_seconds', v_meme.duration_seconds
    ),
    'pending', 0, 3, p_created_by
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_queue_id;
  
  UPDATE audio_memes SET use_count = use_count + 1 WHERE id = p_audio_meme_id;
  
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'queue_id', v_queue_id,
    'meme_name', v_meme.name,
    'meme_category', v_meme.category,
    'ptt', true,
    'audio_url', v_meme.audio_url,
    'remote_jid', p_remote_jid,
    'instance_name', p_instance_name
  );
END;
$function$

=== zapp.fn_send_sticker(p_remote_jid text, p_instance_name text, p_sticker_id uuid, p_created_by uuid) [] SCALAR jsonb
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.fn_send_sticker(p_remote_jid text, p_instance_name text, p_sticker_id uuid, p_created_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sticker record;
  v_queue_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Buscar figurinha no catalogo
  SELECT * INTO v_sticker FROM stickers WHERE id = p_sticker_id AND is_active = true;
  IF v_sticker IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'sticker_id nao encontrado ou inativo');
  END IF;
  
  -- 2. Inserir na fila de envio
  INSERT INTO outbound_message_queue (
    remote_jid, instance_name, message_type, content,
    media_url, media_mime_type, sticker_id,
    metadata, status, retry_count, max_retries, created_by
  ) VALUES (
    p_remote_jid, p_instance_name, 'sticker', '',
    v_sticker.image_url, COALESCE(v_sticker.mime_type, 'image/webp'), p_sticker_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'sticker_name', v_sticker.name,
      'sticker_category', v_sticker.category,
      'is_animated', v_sticker.is_animated
    ),
    'pending', 0, 3, p_created_by
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_queue_id;
  
  -- 3. Incrementar use_count
  UPDATE stickers SET use_count = COALESCE(use_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = p_sticker_id;
  
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'queue_id', v_queue_id,
    'sticker_name', v_sticker.name,
    'sticker_category', v_sticker.category,
    'is_animated', v_sticker.is_animated,
    'image_url', v_sticker.image_url,
    'remote_jid', p_remote_jid,
    'instance_name', p_instance_name
  );
END;
$function$

=== zapp.record_voice_telemetry(p_queue_id uuid, p_duration_ms integer, p_status text, p_error_type text, p_error_detail text) [] SCALAR void
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.record_voice_telemetry(p_queue_id uuid, p_duration_ms integer, p_status text, p_error_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_error_detail text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE zapp.voice_conversion_queue
  SET status = p_status, duration_ms = p_duration_ms,
      error_message = COALESCE(p_error_detail, error_message),
      error_code = p_error_type,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN p_status IN ('completed','failed') THEN now() ELSE completed_at END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = p_queue_id;

  IF p_status = 'failed' AND p_error_type IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO zapp.dev_diagnostic_logs (action, category, details)
    VALUES ('voice_conversion_failed','Voice',
      jsonb_build_object('queue_id',p_queue_id,'duration_ms',p_duration_ms,'error_type',p_error_type));
  END IF;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.rpc_email_mark_thread_read(p_thread_id uuid, p_read boolean, p_unread boolean, p_message_ids uuid[]) [] SCALAR jsonb
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.rpc_email_mark_thread_read(p_thread_id uuid, p_read boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_unread boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_message_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_unread boolean;
BEGIN
  v_unread := CASE WHEN p_unread IS NOT NULL THEN p_unread
                   WHEN p_read   IS NOT NULL THEN NOT p_read
                   ELSE false END;

  UPDATE email_app.email_threads SET is_unread = v_unread, updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_thread_id;

  UPDATE email_app.email_messages SET is_read = NOT v_unread
  WHERE thread_id = p_thread_id AND (p_message_ids IS NULL OR id = ANY(p_message_ids));

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('updated', true, 'thread_id', p_thread_id, 'is_unread', v_unread);
END;
$function$

=== zapp.rpc_get_contact_summary_batch(p_contact_ids uuid[]) [] SETOF record
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.rpc_get_contact_summary_batch(p_contact_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid, unread_whispers integer, pending_tasks integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp'
AS $function$
WITH unread_w AS (
  SELECT contact_id, COUNT(*)::int AS cnt
  FROM zapp.whisper_messages
  WHERE contact_id = ANY(p_contact_ids) AND is_read = false
  GROUP BY contact_id
), pending_t AS (
  SELECT contact_id, COUNT(*)::int AS cnt
  FROM zapp.conversation_tasks
  WHERE contact_id = ANY(p_contact_ids) AND status = 'pending'
  GROUP BY contact_id
)
SELECT ids.id AS contact_id,
       COALESCE(uw.cnt, 0) AS unread_whispers,
       COALESCE(pt.cnt, 0) AS pending_tasks
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(p_contact_ids) AS id) ids
LEFT JOIN unread_w uw ON uw.contact_id = ids.id
LEFT JOIN pending_t pt ON pt.contact_id = ids.id
$function$

=== zapp.rpc_get_pipeline_health_v2(p_instance_name text) [] SETOF record
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.rpc_get_pipeline_health_v2(p_instance_name text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(checked_at timestamp with time zone, instance_name text, pending_messages bigint, stuck_messages_5m bigint, stuck_messages_30m bigint, failed_messages_24h bigint, oldest_pending_minutes double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ,
    m.instance_name::TEXT,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status IN ('pending','queued'))::BIGINT,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status='pending' AND m.created_at < NOW()-INTERVAL '5 minutes')::BIGINT,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status='pending' AND m.created_at < NOW()-INTERVAL '30 minutes')::BIGINT,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status='failed'  AND m.created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '24 hours')::BIGINT,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-MIN(CASE WHEN m.status='pending' THEN m.created_at END)))/60)::DOUBLE PRECISION
  FROM zapp.messages m
  WHERE (p_instance_name IS NULL OR m.instance_name::TEXT = p_instance_name)
  GROUP BY m.instance_name;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.rpc_log_email_health(p_status text, p_operation text, p_resource text, p_request_id text, p_error_message text, p_metadata jsonb, p_is_failure boolean, p_account_id uuid) [] SCALAR jsonb
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.rpc_log_email_health(p_status text, p_operation text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_resource text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_error_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_is_failure boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_account_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_failure_count integer := 0;
  v_is_failure boolean := COALESCE(p_is_failure, p_status IN ('error','degraded'));
  -- status para a coluna do summary respeita a CHECK; valores fora do dominio viram 'unknown'
  v_summary_status text := CASE WHEN p_status IN ('healthy','degraded','error','unknown') THEN p_status
                                WHEN p_status = 'ok' THEN 'healthy'
                                ELSE 'unknown' END;
BEGIN
  -- log bruto preserva o p_status original (a tabela de logs nao tem CHECK)
  INSERT INTO zapp.email_health_logs (account_id, status, operation, resource, request_id, error_message, metadata, is_failure)
  VALUES (p_account_id, p_status, p_operation, p_resource, p_request_id, p_error_message, p_metadata, v_is_failure);

  SELECT failure_count INTO v_failure_count FROM zapp.email_health_summary WHERE id = 'current';
  IF v_is_failure THEN
    v_failure_count := COALESCE(v_failure_count, 0) + 1;
  ELSE
    v_failure_count := 0;
  END IF;

  UPDATE zapp.email_health_summary
  SET status = v_summary_status, failure_count = v_failure_count, last_checked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = 'current';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('logged', true, 'status', p_status, 'summary_status', v_summary_status, 'failure_count', v_failure_count);
END;
$function$

=== zapp.search_knowledge_base(search_query text, max_results integer) [] SETOF record
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.search_knowledge_base(search_query text, max_results integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, content text, category text, tags text, rank real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$ SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.category, a.tags, CASE WHEN a.title ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' THEN 1.0 WHEN a.content ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END::real AS rank FROM zapp.knowledge_base_articles a WHERE a.is_published = true AND (a.title ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%' OR a.content ILIKE '%' || search_query || '%') ORDER BY rank DESC LIMIT max_results; $function$

=== zapp.sicoob_outbox_claim(p_batch_size integer) [] SETOF record
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.sicoob_outbox_claim(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, payload jsonb, status text, attempt_count integer, next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT s.id
    FROM   zapp.sicoob_reply_outbox s
    WHERE  s.status = 'pending'
      AND  (s.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR s.next_attempt_at <= now())
    ORDER BY s.created_at ASC
    LIMIT  p_batch_size
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  )
  UPDATE zapp.sicoob_reply_outbox s
  SET    status = 'processing',
         attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
         next_attempt_at = now() + INTERVAL '1 minute'
  FROM   claimed
  WHERE  s.id = claimed.id
  RETURNING s.id, s.payload, s.status, s.attempt_count, s.next_attempt_at, s.created_at;
END;
$function$

=== zapp.validate_reset_token(p_token text) [] SCALAR uuid
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zapp.validate_reset_token(p_token text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zapp', 'monitoring'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_hashed text;
BEGIN
  v_hashed := encode(extensions.digest(p_token::bytea, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  
  SELECT user_id INTO v_user_id
  FROM zapp.password_reset_requests
  WHERE reset_token = v_hashed
    AND status = 'pending'
    AND token_expires_at > now()
  LIMIT 1;
  
  RETURN v_user_id;
END;
$function$
